fields.label: Tag Name
fields.description: Lowercase with underscores, for example payment_issue. It cannot be changed later.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Only active tags are offered to the AI.

fields.label: Default Tag
fields.description: Used when the AI cannot place a message, and for messages that are skipped.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: The order the tags are listed to the AI.

fields.label: Dashboard Group
fields.description: Which workspace card counts this tag: Enquiries or Issues. Leave empty for neither.

fields.label: Description for the AI
fields.description: When this tag applies. This text is given to the AI, so be specific.

fields.label: When a Message Gets This Tag
fields.description: What the app does for each message with this tag. No rows means the tag only labels the message.
